name: 2026 Fall — Catch, Footwork & Speed
goal: Fix the catch (elbows, knees, feet) and first-pull knee position, build speed above the knee and lockout, then test with a Week 6 max-out and a Week 12 Olympic Total. Week-to-week variation keeps twice-a-week training fresh while still building toward each 6-week goal.

phases.title: MESOCYCLE 1 — CATCH, FOOTWORK & FIRST-PULL POSITION
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–6 · 9/14–10/24 · Build through Week 5, then Week 6 Saturday is a max-out test on both lifts (Week 6 Monday is light prep)

intent.title: Week 1 · 9/14–9/19
intent.text: Positions are rebuilt away from the floor first. No-feet snatch/clean forces a disciplined, narrow catch by removing foot movement entirely; muscle snatch/clean removes the leg re-bend that lets the knees-forward habit sneak in; the halting deadlift drills the knee-back reversal directly. Sots press opens both days as a lockout/mobility primer. No full lift from the floor yet.

exercises.name: Press in Snatch (Sots Press)
exercises.note: Snatch-width grip, bar behind neck, sit into the bottom — press to lockout. Sots press for the receiving position

exercises.name: Halting Snatch Deadlift (pause below knee)
exercises.note: Pause 3s, then consciously reverse the knees back before continuing — the knees-forward fix

exercises.name: No-Feet Snatch
exercises.note: Feet stay in the pull stance the whole rep — no jump, no reset

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: No leg re-bend — forces correct knee/hip sequencing instead of a floor pull

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Knees out through the whole rep
